wait_for_agent: wait for an Azure DevOps agent to come online in a specified agent pool
deregister_agent: deregister and remove an Azure DevOps agent from its agent pool
get_pool_id: get the numeric pool ID for a named Azure DevOps agent pool
get_auth_header: build a Basic auth header dictionary from an Azure DevOps personal access token
run_cli: run the CLI to wait for or deregister an Azure DevOps agent by name
